title: Robots.txt Generator
seoTitle: Robots.txt Generator — Crawl Rules and Sitemap
description: Generate a robots.txt file with user-agent rules, allow and disallow paths, and an optional sitemap URL. Edit locally, then copy the file.
intro: Choose a default policy, list paths to block or allow, and add a sitemap URL. The generator writes a robots.txt body you can place at your site root.
blurb: Generate robots.txt crawl rules with allow, disallow and sitemap lines.

options.label: Allow all, then disallow listed paths
Disallow all, then allow listed paths

howItWorks: Set the user-agent. A star applies the group to every crawler that does not have its own group.
Pick a default policy and list paths that are exceptions, one path per line.
Add a sitemap URL if you have one, then generate and copy the file to your site root.
examples: Allow all with /admin disallowed blocks that path while leaving the rest crawlable.
Disallow all with /public allowed is a closed default plus an exception.
A sitemap line points crawlers at https://example.com/sitemap.xml.

faq.a: No. It is a crawl hint, not access control. Sensitive URLs still need authentication even if they are disallowed.
Place it at the host root, for example https://example.com/robots.txt. A file in a subfolder is not the standard location.
